data.title: Vacancies by Entity

metadata.label: Keywords
metadata.value: Vacancies, Job openings, Entity, Establishment, Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Statistical population
metadata.value: The statistical population includes all individuals aged 15 years and above who reside in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The following are excluded: visitors to the Emirate who have stayed for less than six months, residents of institutions such as hospitals, psychiatric facilities, elderly care homes, orphanages, and hotels, members of the diplomatic corps, armed forces personnel, security camps, and palace residents.

metadata.label: Geographic coverage
metadata.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.

metadata.label: Statistical calculation method
metadata.value: Total number of vacant job positions reported by each establishment in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi on an annual basis.

data.description: Total number of vacancies broken down by major entities in Abu Dhabi.

aiRecommendation.title: Target High-Vacancy Entities for Targeted Emiratisation Programmes
aiRecommendation.title_ar: استهداف الجهات ذات الشواغر الوظيفية العالية لبرامج التوطين المخصصة
aiRecommendation.text: Mubadala Investment Company and Emirates Telecommunications Corporation report the highest vacancy counts, presenting prime opportunities for structured Emiratisation and graduate placement initiatives.
aiRecommendation.text_ar: تُسجّل شركة مبادلة للاستثمار ومؤسسة الاتصالات الإماراتية أعلى أعداد الوظائف الشاغرة، مما يوفر فرصاً مثالية لمبادرات التوطين المنظّمة وبرامج توظيف الخريجين.
aiRecommendation.reason: Vacancy distribution across key Abu Dhabi entities reveals concentrated demand in investment, telecommunications, and energy sectors. Aligning national talent pipelines with these entities can accelerate workforce localisation.
aiRecommendation.reason_ar: يكشف توزيع الوظائف الشاغرة عبر الجهات الرئيسية في أبوظبي عن تركّز الطلب في قطاعات الاستثمار والاتصالات والطاقة. إن مواءمة مسارات المواهب الوطنية مع هذه الجهات يمكن أن تُسرّع توطين القوى العاملة.
